in_sanskrit.name: चोक्षि
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord of the eyes or beautiful eyes
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chokshi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'chakshu' which means 'eye'. The suffix 'shi' is a common suffix in Sanskrit that denotes 'lord' or 'master'. So, Chokshi can be interpreted as 'Lord of the eyes' or 'Beautiful eyes'.

in_hindi.name: चोक्षि
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chokshi is the same in Hindi as it is in Sanskrit.

in_tamil.name: சோக்ஷி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Chokshi in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'chakshu' which means 'eye'. The Tamil suffix 'shi' also denotes 'lord' or 'master'. So, Chokshi can be interpreted as 'Lord of beautiful eyes' or 'Beautiful eyes' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: చోఖేశి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Chokshi in Telugu is also the same as it is in Sanskrit and Tamil. It can be interpreted as 'Lord of beautiful eyes' or 'Beautiful eyes'.

in_marathi.name: Chokshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chokshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chokshi is a Sanskrit name that originated from the Goddess of wealth, Lakshmi. She is considered the bringer of prosperity, fortune, and abundance. Chokshi is also associated with fertility and good luck.
